title: elaeagnus umbellata f. parvifolia
intro: Elaeagnus umbellata f. parvifolia, commonly known as American Silverberry or Wolfberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Elaeagnus umbellata f. parvifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall health.
